topic: Protests against the WA government plan to merge UWA, Curtin and Murdoch universities (university students marched on Parliament House in Perth)
scale: more than 300 university students and staff marched (ABC); about 200 staff, students and union members (WA Today)
quote1: More than 300 university students and staff have marched on Parliament House to protest a controversial plan to merge three of Western Australia's four public universities.
quote2: Shadow education minister Liam Staltari has received a frosty reception from about 200 staff, students and union members protesting the state government’s proposed university merger outside Parliament House on Wednesday.
